name: Ruins of Lordaeron
summary: Above Undercity, the Ruins of Lordaeron still shelter horrors from the fallen capital. Prince Arthas and the Scourge brought the human kingdom to ruin during the Third War. Now the Alliance and Horde venture across the surface to reclaim relics of the past or purge its threats.

sections.title: A Fallen Empire's Courtyard
sections.body:
Capital City once held the crown of the Eastern Kingdoms. King Terenas Menethil II sat on its throne, and human civilization stood at its heart. When Prince Arthas returned from Northrend, he killed his father in the throne room and unleashed the undead upon the people.

The Forsaken now dwell in the catacombs below, in Undercity. Above them, the surface remains a forsaken twilight zone. Broken arches and weed-choked cobbles shelter feral beasts such as Witherfang and deranged remnants of the past.

sections.title: Torment and Pestilence
sections.body:
Restless dead are not the only danger in the ruined grounds. Apothecaries and sinister figures such as viktor the vile test new plagues in the shadows, while twisted experiments such as the abandoned roam freely.

Wrathful spirits such as rath'mael and cursed retainers such as The Baron haunt the collapsed halls, trapped in endless torment. They strike at any living or undead trespasser who crosses their path.

sections.title: Ghosts of the Royal Guard
sections.body: Spectral defenders linger among the upper ruins, with a ghostly Lordaeron Captain among them. Still bound to their shattered oaths, these apparitions see anyone nearing the throne as an invader. Putting the Captain and their soldiers to rest ends a bitter vigil that has endured since the capital fell.

faq.q: Where is the Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon located?
faq.answer: The Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon occupies the surface of Capital City in Tirisfal Glades, directly above the entrance network leading down to the Forsaken capital of Undercity.

faq.q: Why are both the Horde and Alliance interested in this place?
faq.answer: The Alliance ventures into Lordaeron to recover lost family heirlooms, gather royal crests, and bring peace to fallen ancestors. The Horde, especially the Forsaken, seeks to secure Undercity's perimeter and obtain research samples for the Royal Apothecary Society's new plague.
viktor the vile is a sinister figure exploiting the ruins' lawlessness with foul experiments. His work adds to the corruption and twisted abominations infesting the upper capital.

faq.q: What is 'The Abandoned' encountered in the ruins?
faq.answer: the abandoned is a grotesque undead monstrosity left behind in the ruins. Like many patchwork horrors created during or after the Scourge's conquest, it wanders the derelict chambers aimlessly and attacks anything it encounters.

faq.q: What does defeating the Lordaeron Captain mean for the story?
faq.answer: Defeating the spectral Lordaeron Captain frees a high-ranking royal defender from a perpetual, maddening duty. Bound by honor since the Scourge's first massacre, the Captain has guarded a destroyed kingdom for years, and that vigil has endured since the capital fell. Laying the Captain to rest ends an agonizing cycle of phantom servitude and lets the bloodied insignia be reclaimed.

faq.q: Is the Ruins of Lordaeron separate from the Undercity?
faq.answer: Yes. The Forsaken make their home in Undercity's caverns below, while the surface ruins remain an active combat zone filled with restless ghosts, feral predators, and experimental threats the Forsaken have not fully eradicated.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the ruins above are their former home and eternal graveyard. Clearing them secures their front door and supplies the apothecaries with components for developing the New Plague.
As a human, you may see the ruined capital as hallowed ground stolen through betrayal, and seek lost heirlooms and a way to honor fallen kin.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can strike at the threshold of the Forsaken capital while bringing justice and peace to the spirits of your slaughtered northern brothers.
As a paladin, you walk the desecrated halls of Lordaeron, cradle of the Knights of the Silver Hand, to purge horrors and lay restless captains to rest in service to the Light.
